storage.built_in: Surveillance class HDD: 2 TB, 4 TB or 8 TB by variant

power.supply: Power supply 50–60 Hz, 100–240 V AC, max 90 W; recorder 1.88 A, 48 V DC, max 90 W

features: Integrated PoE switch: 8x RJ45 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX PoE, 1x RJ45 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T uplink
Video compression: H.264, H.265 (depending on camera support)
Supports all camera resolutions and frame rates
Compatible with AXIS Camera Station Edge, AXIS Camera Station Pro and partner video management software
Axis Edge Vault, TPM 2.0 (CC EAL4+, FIPS 140-2 Level 2)
notes: poe.budget_w is for the 2 TB and 4 TB variants; datasheet gives a total PoE budget of 65 W (2 TB and 4 TB) and 60 W (8 TB).
weight_g is for the 2 TB variant; datasheet gives 1310 g (2 TB), 1350 g (4 TB) and 1450 g (8 TB).
